title: Robot in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1="50" y1="8" x2="50" y2="18" stroke="#7be0ff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="5" fill="#ffd85e"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="2.2" fill="#fff4b0"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <rect x="22" y="17" width="56" height="40" rx="10" fill="#3a4f7a"/>
  <rect x="22" y="17" width="56" height="40" rx="10" fill="none" stroke="#5c7ab0" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x="30" y="24" width="40" height="26" rx="6" fill="#0d1830"/>
  <rect x="30" y="24" width="40" height="26" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#4a9fd4" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="34" r="5" fill="#7be0ff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="34" r="5" fill="#7be0ff"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="34" r="2" fill="#d8f7ff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="34" r="2" fill="#d8f7ff"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 42 Q50 48 58 42" fill="none" stroke="#7be0ff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- scarf wrap -->
  <path d="M25 55 Q35 50 50 55 Q65 60 75 55 L75 65 Q65 70 50 65 Q35 60 25 65 Z" fill="#ff5d73"/>
  <path d="M25 55 Q35 50 50 55 Q65 60 75 55" fill="none" stroke="#ff9aa8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d="M64 62 Q70 72 68 82 Q66 90 60 88 Q56 86 58 78 Q61 70 64 62 Z" fill="#ff5d73"/>
  <path d="M64 62 Q70 72 68 82 Q66 90 60 88" fill="none" stroke="#ff9aa8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M63 72 L68 74 M62 79 L67 81 M61 86 L65 87" stroke="#ffb3bd" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <rect x="30" y="60" width="40" height="30" rx="8" fill="#4a6495"/>
  <rect x="30" y="60" width="40" height="30" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#7f9ccc" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- chest light -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="5" fill="#ffd85e"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#fff4b0"/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <rect x="18" y="63" width="10" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#5c7ab0"/>
  <rect x="72" y="63" width="10" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#5c7ab0"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="66.5" r="4.5" fill="#7f9ccc"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="66.5" r="4.5" fill="#7f9ccc"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="38" y="89" width="8" height="7" rx="2" fill="#5c7ab0"/>
  <rect x="54" y="89" width="8" height="7" rx="2" fill="#5c7ab0"/>
  <rect x="35" y="94" width="13" height="4" rx="2" fill="#7f9ccc"/>
  <rect x="52" y="94" width="13" height="4" rx="2" fill="#7f9ccc"/>
</svg>
